name: LucidPro 25K · $600 daily limit (funded)
source: Owner 2026-10-19: compare the 25K Pro eval ($65) with the 25K Flex eval ($45) for JJ Simon's $1,000 plan. Lucid's pages read 2026-10-19: eval https://support.lucidtrading.com/en/articles/12890029-lucidpro-evaluation-account ($1,250 target, $1,000 max loss, daily loss limit NONE on the 25K eval, max 2 minis / 20 micros, 'pass the evaluation in one trading day'); funded https://support.lucidtrading.com/en/articles/12890069-lucidpro-funded-account ($1,000 max loss, $600 daily loss limit, no scaling plan); payouts https://support.lucidtrading.com/en/articles/12890092-lucidpro-payouts (minimum profit goal $250 a cycle, largest day <= 40% of the cycle profit, paid only above the buffer = max loss + $100 = $26,100, minimum request $500 so balance >= $26,600, first payout at most $1,000 at $27,100, later ones $1,500 at $27,600, 90/10 split). The product page for the 25K lists no consistency rule and no daily loss limit on the eval. Everything else (EOD trailing, the lock at +$1,100 -> +$100, what the floor does after a payout) is the 50K Pro file's reading, scaled.
payout_ladder: first payout at most $1,000 (needs $27,100), later $1,500 (needs $27,600); goal, consistency and buffer reset after each payout; 90/10 split
notes: THE EVAL HAS NO DAILY LOSS LIMIT (Lucid's table: None for the 25K); the simulator has one field, so a caller that models the eval must pass a copy of this file with daily_loss_limit null for the eval phase (jj_fifty_accounts --eval-dll none does this). The $600 here is the FUNDED account's.
No consistency rule and no minimum days on the eval: a single day that reaches +$1,250 passes (one full-size 1:1.5 trade can be the whole eval).

PAYOUT: no winning-days rule. Cycle profit >= $250, largest day <= 40% of the cycle profit, paid only above the $26,100 buffer; minimum request $500 (balance >= $26,600); the first payout is at most $1,000 (balance >= $27,100).
UNCONFIRMED: the lock (+$1,100 -> +$100) and the floor after a payout are the 50K Pro reading, scaled; the eval's pass-in-one-day is Lucid's own text.
Price (not used by the simulator): $65 (the owner, 2026-10-19).
Size: 2 minis / 20 micros from the first day, no scaling. NOT enforced by the simulator.
Only the FIRST payout is simulated by propsim.evaluate; jj_fifty_accounts walks every payout.
disclaimer: Illustrative, versioned snapshot -- verify against LucidPro's current rulebook before relying on these numbers.
